Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
database.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
Manages all database operations for the library management system. This utility class handles database initialization, CRUD operations for books, and loan transaction management (borrowing and returning books).
Version:
1.0
Author:
Ahmed

  • Method Details

    • initializeDatabase

      public static void initializeDatabase() throws SQLException
      Initializes the database by creating the required tables ('books' and 'loans') if they do not already exist.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the SQL statements fail

    • addBook

      public static void addBook(String title, String author) throws SQLException
      Adds a new book record to the database with the specified title and author.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book to be added
      author - the author of the book to be added
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the insertion fails

    • updateBook

      public static void updateBook(int id, String title, String author) throws SQLException
      Updates the details of an existing book in the database based on its ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the book to update
      title - the new title to be set
      author - the new author to be set
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the update fails

    • deleteBook

      public static void deleteBook(int id) throws SQLException
      Deletes a book record from the database based on its ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the book to delete
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the deletion fails

    • searchBooks

      public static List<Object[]> searchBooks(String keyword) throws SQLException
      Searches for books whose title or author matches the specified keyword.
      Parameters:
      keyword - the search term used to match against book titles or authors
      Returns:
      a list of Object arrays, where each array contains the book's ID, title, and author
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the query fails

    • issueLoan

      public static void issueLoan(String name, String phone, String title, String date) throws SQLException
      Issues a book loan to a borrower after checking if the book is already borrowed.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the borrower
      phone - the contact phone number of the borrower
      title - the title of the book being borrowed
      date - the due date or return date for the loan
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs, or if the book is already borrowed (throws an exception with the message "ALREADY_BORROWED")

    • returnLoan

      public static void returnLoan(int loanId) throws SQLException
      Returns a borrowed book by removing its corresponding loan record using the loan ID.
      Parameters:
      loanId - the unique ID of the loan record to delete
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the deletion fails

    • getAllLoans

      public static List<Object[]> getAllLoans() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all current loan records from the database.
      Returns:
      a list of Object arrays, each representing a loan record with loan ID, book title, borrower name, borrower phone, and return date
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the query fails
